evidence.quote: ## 1. An exact entropy representation for the actual physical encoder

contract.obstruction: Positive curvature at r=0, a D-dependent useful neighborhood, an unconditioned SLD gap or a different filter selected at each history does not establish the required positive conditioned BKM density at a fixed precomputed physical r. Environmental entropy edges across contexts remain uncontrolled, and geometric/Lueders edge replacement lacks a complete compiled no-case proof. Ordinary positive rate and hardness consequences remain conditional. Fixed finite-code SDP convergence is not an effective upper certificate over every block length.
